settings.embed:
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<form xmlns="http://www.demandware.com/xml/form/2008-04-19">

    <field formid="firstname" label="contactus.label.firstname" type="string" mandatory="true" binding="firstName" max-length="50" parse-error="validate.parse-error" missing-error="validate.required"></field>
    <field formid="lastname" label="contactus.label.lastname" type="string" mandatory="true" binding="lastName" max-length="50" parse-error="validate.parse-error" missing-error="validate.required"></field>
    <field formid="email" label="bulkpurchases.label.email" type="string" mandatory="true" parse-error="contactus.email.parse-error" missing-error="validate.required" binding="email" max-length="50" regexp="^[\w.%+-]+@[\w.-]+\.[\w]{2,6}$" validation="${require('*/cartridge/scripts/forms/validator').validateEmail(formfield, 'contactus.email.parse-error')}"></field>
    <field formid="phonenumber" label="bulkpurchases.label.phonenumber" type="string" mandatory="false" binding="orderNumber" missing-error="ordertrack.orderNumber.missing-error"></field>
    <field formid="desiredunit" label="bulkpurchases.label.desiredunit" type="string" mandatory="false" binding="productModel"></field>
    <field formid="desiredquantity" label="bulkpurchases.label.desiredquantity" type="string" mandatory="false" binding="emailSubject" missing-error="ordertrack.orderNumber.missing-error"></field>
    <field formid="comment" label="bulkpurchases.label.comment" type="string" mandatory="false" binding="comment" max-length="500"></field>
    <field formid="companyname" label="bulkpurchases.label.companyname" type="string" mandatory="false" max-length="500"></field>
    <field formid="consent" label="bulkpurchases.label.consent" type="boolean" mandatory="true"></field>

    <field formid="response" type="string" mandatory="true" missing-error="validate.required" value-error="recaptcha.fail" validation="${require('*/utils/form').validate(formfield);}"></field>

    <action formid="send" valid-form="true"></action>
</form>
